description.short: Upscale any image 4× with Real-ESRGAN x4plus, running fully on the Snapdragon NPU (HTP) via QAI AppBuilder.
description.long: Real-ESRGAN x4plus is a state-of-the-art image super-resolution model that upscales images by 4x using an RRDBNet (23 residual-in-residual dense blocks). It runs on the Snapdragon NPU (HTP) via QAI AppBuilder and supports multiple model formats (float DLC, w8a8 quantized DLC, precompiled BIN, FP16 ONNX) and runtimes (HTP, GPU, CPU). Models are auto-downloaded on first run; a default input image is included. The pipeline tiles the input at the model input size, normalizes, auto-detects NCHW/NHWC layout, runs inference, and reassembles the 4x upscaled result.
